summary: Fresh macro and durable-state checks found no new regime change beyond the last verified OPEC+ policy event. Iran's October 4 statement that Hormuz will remain closed until seven conditions are met is an authoritative restatement of the conditional-closure posture already reported on August 18 and refined through September negotiations. The net-new detail is that U.S. feedback was received through Qatari intermediaries and the dispute is now described as partly about sequencing; this does not establish a new physical closure, reopening, supply loss, or cross-asset shock. ORACLE therefore keeps the existing graded Hormuz operability/security-risk state unchanged. SUPERMESH-X treats Reuters, Press TV/Tasnim and downstream reports as multiple publications tracing to the same Iranian official origin, not independent physical-flow corroboration.

evidence.observed_finding: Latest durable Macro state records the verified October 4 OPEC+ November-target decision.
Iran's parliament speaker reiterated conditional Hormuz closure; Reuters also reported active Qatari-mediated messaging and unresolved sequencing.
The same core conditional-closure position was already public on August 18, preventing promotion of the October 4 restatement as a new shock.
Iran had already conveyed reopening conditions to the United States in September.
Iranian state media carries the official-origin claim; it is not independent evidence of aggregate vessel traffic or export throughput.

A complete recursive tree filename scan found no Hormuz/Iran-named event in Icarus-engine; GitHub code search for the exact reopening phrase returned zero results but flagged the result set incomplete, so absence is not treated as exhaustive content proof.

blockers: Traditional cross-asset markets were closed for the weekend, so no synchronized NQ, Treasury, DXY, gold, crude, volatility or breadth response could be established.
No verified aggregate Hormuz vessel count, physical export-throughput, freight, insurance or reserve-release dataset newer than the prior durable state was available in this cycle.
